merge_rules: Apply after the 2026-10-02 supplement. Append options and configurations; a duplicate option or configuration id is an error.

options.description: HappyModel EP2 ExpressLRS 2.4 GHz nano receiver, SMD ceramic antenna

corroborating_sources.note: EP2 RX AUD 21.99 (ex GST 19.99); stock not specified; CRSF output, 500 Hz maximum refresh, 5 V, 10 x 10 x 6 mm, 0.44 g
USD 20.49 in a search summary; page not inspected

limitations: Cube FPV does not print GST status, so the conservative case applies no deduction.
Receiver and transmitter ExpressLRS versions and binding phrase must match; the transmitter is excluded GSE.
Telemetry power is not listed; installed ceramic-antenna range near the ESC and motor wiring is unverified.
The receiver is not an independent hardware kill; failsafe and inhibit behaviour must be configured and range-tested before free flight.

options.description: 623-ZZS-ECO ball bearings, 3 x 10 x 4 mm, double shielded, chrome steel; two packs of two for two bearings per gimbal axis
limitations: The price is printed exclusive of GST only.
Load ratings and limiting speed were not in the extracted text.
Pivots need plain-shank M3 shoulder screws or pins; threads bearing on the inner race are not acceptable in the final design.
Replaces the 688ZZ option, which needed separate 8 mm pivot pins; the CAD gimbal design must confirm the choice.

options.description: Gator RC adjustable pushrod linkage kit with ball links, 65 mm, M3
options.section: Title, price, stock and pack contents

key_specifications.screws: 4 x M3 x 20 mm socket head

limitations: US storefront; the page states free shipping only within the USA and does not address Australian delivery.
The adjustment range is not listed; the 65 mm rod length must match the CAD linkage geometry.
Ball-link play adds actuator backlash, which must be measured on the gimbal.
Nylon composite sockets; load capacity is not listed.

options.description: SparkFun M3 hex nuts for nut traps in printed parts
options.availability: In stock, ships same business day

key_specifications.price_break: 25+ at AUD 0.10 ex GST, not applied

limitations: Plain hex nuts without nylon inserts; vibrating joints need thread-locking compound or the four locking nuts in the linkage kit.
The quantity of 30 is an assumption pending the CAD fastener schedule.
No washers are purchased; printed bearing faces must be sized for M3 screw heads.

options.description: SparkFun XT60 male/female pair, used as a removable shorted arming link in the battery positive lead
options.availability: In stock, ships same business day
limitations: Carries full pack current. The 40 A screening reserve case reaches about 36 to 42 A, within the 65 A listing, but contact heating is unmeasured.
No anti-spark feature; the arming procedure must connect the link with the vehicle restrained and the receiver inhibit active.
A manual safety disconnect, not a remote kill.

options.description: SparkFun XT60 male/female pair mating an XT60-terminated battery to the vehicle harness
options.availability: In stock, ships same business day
limitations: Used only with the XT60-terminated Ovonic battery; contact temperature must be measured in endurance tests.

options.description: SparkFun 10 kOhm 1/4 W through-hole resistors, 20 pack, for the battery-voltage divider
options.availability: 37 from local stock plus supplier stock

key_specifications.proposed_divider: Five in series (50 kOhm) over one (10 kOhm): a 16.8 V full pack gives 2.80 V at a 3.3 V ADC input

limitations: The 5% tolerance requires calibration against a meter; no filter capacitor is purchased.
The divider draws about 0.28 mA while connected; disconnect the battery for storage.
The divider design is conceptual pending the interface document.

options.description: 60 x 80 mm protoboard for the divider, signal distribution and receiver mounting
options.availability: Available with a lead time; dispatch expected 12 to 15 October

key_specifications.holes: 22 x 27 at 2.54 mm pitch plus side pads

limitations: Single- or double-sided plating is not stated.
Lead time of about two weeks.

options.description: Female/female 200 mm jumper wire ribbon, 40 pieces, for controller, sensor and receiver signals
options.availability: In stock, ships same business day
limitations: Unlatched 2.54 mm housings can loosen under vibration; they need retention, and the final harness follows the CAD routing.

options.description: APC 13x6.5E Thin Electric, normal rotation, SKU LP13065E (re-fetched evidence)
conflicts: Currency shown only as a dollar symbol; USD inferred.
limitations: The APC Thin Electric suggested limit of 150000 divided by the diameter in inches applies.
Adapter fit to the motor collet adapter and positive retention are unverified.

options.description: Ovonic 130C 4S 4000 mAh LiPo with XT60, two-battery purchase unit (re-fetched evidence)
options.availability: Ships from Australia Warehouse; stock quantity not stated
conflicts: The 2026-10-03 title cites RC cars, whereas the 2026-10-02 title at the same URL cited RC airplanes and EDF; the specifications are unchanged.

The second battery is a spare forced by the purchase unit.

options.description: PPS fibreboard mailing tube 90 x 850 mm, candidate rocket-body fairing (cost comparison only)
options.availability: Stock not stated in extracted text
limitations: Wall thickness, material and mass are not listed. An assumed 1.5 mm fibreboard wall at 700 kg/m3 implies about 0.25 kg, more than the remaining screening mass margin; weigh before any selection.
Moisture- and impact-sensitive; not a structural member.
Included only in a comparison configuration, pending the fairing decision.

open_items.description: chief_priced_bom_compute.py revision 1 rejects the evidence grades and price basis added here. Revise it to merge evidence_grades_added and price_basis_codes_added additively and to treat au_printed_ex_gst_only as a printed GST-exclusive price, then recompute with both supplements.

The rocket-shaped body or fairing material and mass are unselected. Candidates: fibreboard mailing tube (mass unlisted, likely about 0.25 kg), printed PETG shell from the purchased spool (mass from CAD) or foam sheet (no traceable listing). Confirm with the human whether 'rocket-shaped' requires a full-length fairing or permits an open spine with a printed nose cone and fins.

The HobbyKing Turnigy Graphene listing returned HTTP 403 on 2026-10-02 and 2026-10-03. C14 uses the Ovonic two-pack shipped from an Australian warehouse at a previewed net increase of about AUD 20. A human-supplied quotation could restore the cheaper pack; the Ovonic internal resistance must be measured.
The 623ZZ gimbal bearings need plain-shank M3 pivots (shoulder screws or pins). Confirm availability and fit from the CAD fastener schedule, or revert to 688ZZ bearings with 8 mm pins.
Cube FPV lists two EP2 receivers and FPVFaster does not state stock; reconfirm at purchase.
RCDrone lists a 50 to 432 Hz PWM input for the Skywalker 40A V2. Keep the simulated and planned ESC command rate within this range, and confirm it in the manufacturer manual and on the test stand.
The X2814 19 x 19 mm, 3 mm hole pattern comes only from a search summary. Obtain a drawing or measure the delivered X mount before fixing the CAD motor interface.
